summary_en: ¥55/share interim dividend (vs. ¥50 prior forecast); full-year dividend raised to ¥110/share (+¥10). Interim payout ¥1,888M. Increase driven by upward revision of FY10/26 earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice regarding surplus dividend (interim dividend) and revision of dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: On 5 June 2026, Kanamoto announced an increase in its interim dividend to ¥55/share (vs. ¥50 previously forecast) and revised its full-year FY10/26 dividend forecast to ¥110/share, comprising ¥55 interim and ¥55 year-end, representing a ¥10 increase from the prior forecast of ¥100/share. The interim dividend totals ¥1,888 million and will be effective 2 July 2026. The company attributed the increase to an upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance for the period ended October 2026, following results of the second quarter. Kanamoto stated its dividend policy aims to provide stable base-level dividends regardless of business conditions, supplemented by progressive incremental payouts tied to earnings performance, while maintaining financial strength and internal reserves for future business initiatives.
